adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the code now performs a token refresh fetch to `https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token` before creating the `jsforce.Connection`, on every invocation (no conditional/expiry check). It uses `refresh_token: credentialKey.refresh_token` with no guard that `credentialKey.refresh_token` exists, so credentials lacking a refresh token will send `refresh_token=undefined` via `URLSearchParams` and likely fail. The success check `if (response.statusText !== "OK")` is also fragile compared to `response.ok`/status code checks.
